query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(cause_message.trigger_sequence_id, cause_inference.sequence_id) AS "cause_sequence_id!: i64" FROM sequence_cause LEFT JOIN tool_execution ON tool_execution.id = sequence_cause.source_tool_execution_id LEFT JOIN message AS cause_message ON cause_message.id = sequence_cause.source_message_id LEFT JOIN inference AS cause_inference ON cause_inference.id = COALESCE(tool_execution.inference_id, cause_message.source_inference_id) WHERE sequence_cause.child_sequence_id = ? AND COALESCE(cause_message.trigger_sequence_id, cause_inference.sequence_id) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
